issues.detail: The skill does not cover error handling for network failures, authentication errors, or unexpected agent responses, leaving edge cases unaddressed.
The skill contains verbose explanatory text and repeated sections, which could be trimmed for brevity.

scenarios.name: minimal-a2a-server
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric, while Response A does not implement any of the required SDK components.

scenarios.name: nodejs-a2a-client
scenarios.rationale: Response A uses the SDK and streams the answer, but fails to import and use ClientFactory.createFromUrl as required; Response B does not use the SDK at all.

scenarios.name: python-multi-agent-orchestrator
scenarios.rationale: Response B meets the rubric with async ask, a2a SDK usage, streaming, sequential calls, and printing; Response A uses requests, no async, and misses the required a2a functions.
